title: Dexter
synopsis: Blood-spatter analyst Dexter Morgan leads a double life: by day he works Miami Metro Homicide, by night he hunts killers under Harry's Code, dispatching child-killer Mike Donovan and the rapist Jamie Jaworski. As his sister Debra pushes for a Homicide role, Miami Metro investigates dismembered, bloodless victims; Dexter develops a refrigerated-truck theory. An unidentified killer makes personal contact, throwing a severed head at Dexter's car and leaving a dismembered doll in his apartment, while Dexter's relationship with Rita edges toward an intimacy he is unready for.
